decomposition_formula: For X=N*mean, count contribution=(N12-N11)*(mean12+mean11)/2, mean contribution=(mean12-mean11)*(N12+N11)/2. N includes only requests with usage; missing costs remain unknown. Descriptive arithmetic, not causal savings.
limitations: Topic means current observable assignment context, not every token semantically belongs to that challenge.
Lead, idle/unresolved and unidentified direct API remain separate; no forced allocation.
Characters are text exposure and cannot be treated as billed token counts.
Cross-challenge history is a strict lower bound using issued tool identities; ordinary old prose without call ids is excluded.
Repeated history, cross-challenge history, large tool results, and failed calls overlap; do not add their associated token totals.
Observed total_tokens is authoritative per provider; reasoning can be a completion subset or additional total, depending on provider.

identity_correction.adopted: Clear an explicit null assignment, and do not assign an available-work notice without assignment to the old challenge. Keep idle/unresolved as a separate bucket.
